records.text: :tada: New signup: *Timber Studio* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets. Three outbound emails (email:5dd6d3e1, email:d6415c04, email:edc3e1d9) drew no customer reply at all, suggesting low engagement. Paid Team plan gives some upside, so not negligible, but unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: One first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

I know a few notes from us have landed in your inbox already, so I'll keep this short. Nothing is set up in your Wrenfield workspace yet, and the first step is smaller than it looks: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually enough to make the rest click.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'll walk through creating that first project with you and answer anything about your Team plan while we're there.

Best,
Chidi
